title: Industrial Safety Culture Campaign — 'Safe Hands, Strong Future'
objective: Build workplace safety awareness across Myanmar manufacturing sector during monsoon season (July peak risk period); drive 300+ safety-trained workers through digital touchpoints; position client brand as safety-first industry leader.
target_audience: Manufacturing plant managers (25–55), safety officers, shift supervisors, factory workers (18–45) across textile, food processing, rubber, and automotive parts industries in Yangon and Mandalay.
key_activities: Safety-themed social content series (8 posts, 2-week cadence): monsoon hazards, PPE compliance, incident prevention narratives
3 short-form safety video testimonials (45–60s each): real factory workers on safe practices; CapCut rapid-cut style for engagement
WhatsApp + Viber broadcast campaigns targeting 2,000+ safety contacts with weekly safety tips and compliance reminders
Paid Facebook/TikTok campaign targeting manufacturing demographic (15–20M MMK budget) with custom audience lookalike on existing client employee base
In-plant poster/decal production (5 designs, 500 units total) for site distribution — printed safety messaging + QR link to video library
Weekly organic social management + community response (WhatsApp group moderation for 3 plant manager networks)
kpis: 300+ worker video views (minimum 80% completion rate on 45s videos)
2,000 WhatsApp/Viber messages delivered + 25% engagement rate (clicks to safety resources)
5,000+ impressions on paid social; 4% CTR on safety-training landing page
150 qualified leads (plant managers requesting in-plant safety training consultation)
8 safety-related posts averaging 150+ engagements per post (Yangon manufacturing audience)
why_now: July monsoon rains increase workplace hazards (slippery floors, electrical risks, heat stress). Manufacturing sector faces peak incident reporting in Q3 (safety audits, compliance reviews). Client can position brand as proactive safety partner before Aug–Sep regulatory season. School holidays mean safety officers have budget approval windows before end of fiscal cycle.
deliverables: 8 original social media posts (text + graphics) across FB/IG/TikTok
3 worker safety testimonial videos (45–60s, subtitled Burmese/English)
1 WhatsApp/Viber broadcast content calendar (8 tips + links)
Paid social campaign setup (3 ad variants, targeting specs, daily budget allocation)
5 printable safety poster designs (high-res, 1,200×1,800px, print-ready 300DPI)
Weekly organic social management (posting, community response, hashtag monitoring)

title: Industrial Machinery Expo & Trade Show — 3-Day July Summit
objective: Host 200–250 manufacturing decision-makers (plant managers, purchasing directors, CEOs) for live equipment showcases, technical seminars, and B2B networking; generate 50+ qualified sales leads for heavy machinery distributors and industrial service providers; position client as Myanmar's go-to industrial hub.
target_audience: Plant managers and operations directors (35–60), purchasing executives, factory CEOs, logistics/supply-chain leads from textile mills, food processing plants, rubber factories, automotive parts manufacturers, and steel mills across Yangon, Mandalay, and Bago.
key_activities: 3-day physical expo at Yangon exhibition venue (Yangon Convention Centre or similar); 20–30 branded booths for machinery vendors and equipment demos
Opening keynote session (60 min): industry expert speaker on 'Manufacturing 2026: Tech + Resilience in Myanmar'
4 breakout seminars (2 per day, 90 min each): topics = Lean Manufacturing, IoT in Factories, Supply-Chain Risk, Workplace Safety (July monsoon angle)
Live equipment demonstrations: hydraulic presses, textile looms, food-processing lines (vendor-led, ZYNTH coordinates AV/stage setup)
Networking cocktail (Day 2 evening): VIP booth for top 50 attendees + 5 industry influencers/thought leaders
Digital pre-event campaign (4-week): email invites to 5,000+ target contacts; LinkedIn outreach; WhatsApp group blasts to industry associations
Post-event content: photo recap video (2 min), case-study articles from 3 major exhibitors, social highlights reel (TikTok + FB)
kpis: 250 in-person event attendees (30–50% from target manufacturing segment)
50+ qualified B2B leads captured (business cards + post-event email nurture sequence)
80% attendee satisfaction score (post-event NPS survey, target 7/10+)
5,000+ impressions on pre-event digital campaign; 8% click-through to registration
200+ organic social impressions from live event coverage (TikTok/FB/LinkedIn)
3 post-event case studies published (shared by exhibitors to their networks)
zynth_services: Social Media Management (pre-event promotion, day-of posting)
Content Creation (keynote brief, seminar scripts, post-event video)
PR & Media (press release, industry publication outreach)
Photography & Video (3-day event coverage + recap edit)
why_now: July is school holidays (decision-makers have approval windows); monsoon weather drives indoor event preference; Q3 budget cycles active. Machinery investments peak before Aug–Sep factory expansion push. July event allows 2–3 month sales follow-up before Q4 budget lock. Industrial sector historically less digitally savvy — live event builds brand credibility ZYNTH can amplify post-event digitally.
deliverables: Event run-of-show (3-day detailed schedule, speaker briefs, seminar agendas)
Venue contract + AV/lighting/staging specs (20–30 booth capacity, main stage, breakout rooms)
Pre-event digital campaign (email templates, LinkedIn ads, WhatsApp bulk message, registration landing page)
4 seminar scripts (speaker briefs, slide decks, timing notes)
Photography coverage (150+ edited event photos, 5–7 day turnaround)
Post-event recap video (2–3 min highlight reel: key moments, attendee testimonials, exhibitor demos)
Lead capture sheet + post-event email nurture sequence (5-email series over 4 weeks)

key_activities: Landing page build: 'Is Your Workforce Future-Ready?' quiz + case-study downloads (3 industry-specific PDFs on safety, efficiency, skills gaps)

LinkedIn thought-leadership campaign: 12 posts (bi-weekly) positioning client as 'Myanmar's Manufacturing Skills Authority'; topics = monsoon safety, lean principles, worker retention, digital readiness
TikTok/Reels campaign: 6 short videos (15–30s) showing 'before/after' worker skill gains; rapid-cut testimonials from past training graduates; mobile-first framing
Paid LinkedIn ads targeting HR managers + operations directors (15M MMK budget); Custom audience: Myanmar manufacturing companies >100 employees; lookalike on client's existing contact database
Paid Facebook/TikTok ads (15M MMK) targeting younger supervisors (25–40) with training videos and case studies; demographic-based targeting
Email nurture sequence (10-email series): day 1 welcome + skills audit, day 3 case study, day 7 ROI calculator, day 21 webinar invite, day 45 discount offer
WhatsApp broadcast list building: integrate landing-page CTAs with QR links; direct messaging to 1,000+ HR contacts from industry databases
kpis: 200+ qualified leads (defined as: HR manager/training coordinator, >100-person plant, downloaded case study, opened >2 nurture emails)
8% CTR on paid ads (LinkedIn + TikTok combined); 3% conversion to landing page form submission
500+ email subscribers (organic + paid funnel)
4% open rate on day-1 welcome email; 8% click-through on case-study email
1,200+ TikTok/Reels views; 6% engagement rate (likes + shares + comments)
25+ demo/consultation requests (tracked via landing page form + email response)

Monsoon season = plants invest in indoor upskilling (worker safety, process improvement training). Q3 budget cycles allow fast approval for training initiatives. TikTok + LinkedIn are growing channels in Myanmar manufacturing sector; early positioning wins competitive advantage.

12 LinkedIn posts (captions + images, scheduled 2-week cadence)
6 TikTok/Reels videos (15–30s each, subtitled Burmese, CapCut rapid-cut style, platform-optimized)
Paid ad campaign setup (LinkedIn audience targeting, 3 ad creative variants; TikTok/FB audience + 3 video ads, daily/weekly budget allocation)
10-email nurture sequence (subject lines, copy, CTAs, scheduling calendar)
WhatsApp broadcast strategy (QR link integration, 5 broadcast messages, contact-list sourcing guidelines)

title: Factory Modernization Case Study Film + YouTube Lead-Gen Series
objective: Create 4-part YouTube documentary series following a real manufacturing plant's digital transformation (IoT, automation, waste reduction); position client's technology/consulting brand as trusted advisor for industrial modernization; drive 80+ qualified B2B inquiries from manufacturers seeking similar upgrades.
target_audience: Manufacturing plant managers and CEOs (40–60) considering modernization investments; operations directors evaluating automation; purchasing heads exploring Industry 4.0 solutions; decision-makers on YouTube, LinkedIn, WhatsApp with 100–5,000-person plant operations.
key_activities: Cast selection: identify 1 willing factory partner (textiles, food processing, or automotive parts) undergoing modernization; secure 2–3 week access for filming

Production: shoot 4 episodes (8–12 min each) following the plant's journey — Week 1: Current state + pain points; Week 2: Solution implementation; Week 3: Early wins; Week 4: ROI results. ZYNTH owns concept/script/direction; local production crew handles cameras (Shwe Sin Oo or Wyne rental + freelance DP)
Post-production: color grade (DaVinci), sound mix (Fairlight), motion graphics (factory workflow animations), Burmese/English captions
YouTube channel setup: create dedicated 'Industrial Transformation' series landing page + playlist; optimize titles/descriptions for 'automation Myanmar,' 'Industry 4.0,' 'factory modernization'
Paid YouTube + LinkedIn campaign (20M MMK budget): target 'modernization interest' in-market audiences; geographic targeting Myanmar manufacturing hubs
LinkedIn 'Thought Leadership' series: 8 carousel posts extracting key insights from the film (safety improvements, efficiency gains, cost savings); tag client as featured advisor
Email nurture: build waitlist for 'Factory Modernization Toolkit' (downloadable specs sheet + ROI calculator); integrate with landing page CTAs
Post-series webinar (August): live Q&A with the featured factory's plant manager + client's modernization expert; record for YouTube evergreen library
kpis: 4,000+ YouTube views across 4-episode series (min 800 views per episode within 4 weeks of upload)
12% average CTR on YouTube cards/end screens linking to landing page
80+ qualified B2B inquiries (tracked via landing page form + post-video CTA engagement)
500+ email subscribers on modernization waitlist
3,000+ LinkedIn impressions from 8 carousel posts; 8% engagement rate (likes, shares, comments)
60+ webinar registrations (August follow-up event); 40% attendance rate
zynth_services: Video Production (concept, script, direction, crew coordination)
Social Media Management (LinkedIn carousel posting, YouTube description optimization)
why_now: July monsoon season = manufacturing plants conduct downtime maintenance, making equipment upgrades visible to staff/partners. Q3 budget cycles allow capex decisions on modernization. Documentary format builds trust over 4-week series (higher engagement than single-shot ads). August webinar extends July campaign momentum into back-to-school planning season for factories hiring new roles.
deliverables: 4 x 8–12 minute documentary-style videos (color-graded, sound-mixed, captioned Burmese/English, YouTube-optimized)
YouTube channel setup (custom header, playlist, SEO-optimized descriptions, CTA cards/end screens linked to landing page)
1 landing page (case study summary + 'Modernization Toolkit' download gate, lead capture form)
8 LinkedIn carousel posts (insights from film: safety stats, efficiency gains, ROI figures, 2-week posting schedule)
Paid campaign setup (YouTube in-market audience + Custom Intent targeting, 20M MMK budget allocation, 4-week flight)
Email nurture sequence (5-email series: day-1 welcome, day-7 toolkit download follow-up, day-14 webinar invite, day-28 expert consultation CTA)
Post-series webinar brief (moderator talking points, panelist Q&A prep, email invite + reminder sequence)

title: Industrial Supply-Chain Resilience Webinar Series + Lead Pipeline

target_audience: Supply-chain managers, procurement directors, logistics coordinators (30–55) at mid-market manufacturers; operations directors evaluating risk mitigation; factory owners concerned with monsoon disruptions; decision-makers on email, LinkedIn, WhatsApp.
key_activities: Webinar 1 (early July, 60 min): 'Monsoon Supply-Chain Survival: Risk Mapping & Mitigation' — speaker: industry logistics expert; live Q&A with attendees; recording for on-demand library
Webinar 2 (late July, 60 min): 'Post-Monsoon Recovery: Restocking Strategies & Cost Optimization' — speaker: procurement + sustainability consultant; interactive polling + breakout discussions
Landing page (hosted): webinar registration form (email capture, company/role/plant size), speaker bios, agenda, expected learning outcomes
Pre-webinar email campaign (2-week lead-up): 3-email sequence promoting webinars; LinkedIn event ads; Facebook event page + WhatsApp broadcasts to 2,000+ industry contacts

Paid promotion (15M MMK): LinkedIn event ads targeting supply-chain/logistics keywords in Myanmar; Facebook ads targeting manufacturing decision-makers; Google Ads on supply-chain risk + monsoon keywords
Post-webinar nurture: automated email sequence (welcome video link, downloadable slides + resource guide, client's 'Supply-Chain Risk Assessment' toolkit, calendar invite for 1:1 consultation calls)
Lead scoring: segment attendees by engagement (Q&A participation, poll responses, slides download); flag top 25 for immediate sales follow-up

150+ live attendees (50% attendance rate); 80% watch-to-completion rate
100+ qualified leads (defined as: supply-chain/procurement role, downloaded slides + toolkit, attended >40 min, opened >2 post-webinar emails)
4% CTR on pre-webinar email campaigns; 6% open rate on promotional emails
500+ LinkedIn event-ad impressions; 8% click-through to registration page
50+ calendar holds for post-webinar 1:1 consultation calls (tracked via email CTA)

Email + LinkedIn nurture extends July interest into Aug–Sep B2B sales cycles when manufacturers execute sourcing decisions.
